description: Upload a local file or URL with a workflow attached and, for Architect workflows, wait for the run's outputs. Classic workflows return the ids of the jobs they started (use wait_for_jobs, then get_standardization). Credits: the upload plus each step the workflow runs. Resume an Architect run with workflow_run_job_id.

workflow_run_job_id.description: Resume: the run job returned earlier.

name: run_workflow
title: Run a workflow on a document
